recommended_publication_form.rationale: One 12-page annual compilation of all five approved 2014 minutes, well under the 100-150 page split threshold. Individually the minutes are short procedural records; together they show how the committee was founded, why its first approvals were voided and re-taken, and how the manual's update procedure was adopted. Each original is preserved and cited by its authoritative URL.
recommended_publication_form.standalone_entries: None recommended once the compilation exists.
recommended_publication_form.prerequisite: Two members (August 20 and November 19) are inventory status excluded with no archive copy; Codex must archive and verify them, or record why the compilation proceeds without them, before it is built.
